# Hajree

> Next-generation biometric neural attendance platform with anti-spoofing facial recognition.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://krishujeniya.github.io/MostlyOutlier/
> Live Site: https://krishujeniya.github.io/Hajree/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/Hajree

## Overview
Hajree modernizes institutional and corporate attendance tracking by utilizing high-precision computer vision face embeddings paired with passive anti-spoofing liveness checks.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Canonical Person Entity: https://krishujeniya.github.io/#krishujeniya
- Linked Projects: AGYOS, Hadron, WaferPulse, Somnostasis, Curavex, Scanlark, TraceMigo

## Technical Capabilities
- Computer Vision: MobileNetV2 / ResNet-based facial feature extractor producing 512-D cosine similarity embeddings.
- Anti-Spoofing: Texture-based reflection analysis and blink/micromotion liveness scoring preventing photo/screen replay attacks.
- Workflow: Dual-mode verification (automated edge match + human instructor review queue) with encrypted local record storage.
